problem: James has 30 teeth. His dentist drills 4 of them and caps 7 more teeth than he drills. What percentage of James' teeth does the dentist fix?
pred_smtlib:
(declare-const total_teeth Int)
(declare-const drilled_teeth Int)
(declare-const capped_teeth Int)
(declare-const fixed_percentage Real)
(assert (= total_teeth 30))
(assert (= drilled_teeth 4))
(assert (= capped_teeth (+ drilled_teeth 7)))
(assert (= fixed_percentage (/ (+ drilled_teeth capped_teeth) total_teeth)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (fixed_percentage))

problem: Paul had 108 books. After selling some books in a garage sale and giving 35 books to his friend, he had 150 books left. How many books did he sell in the garage sale?
pred_smtlib:
(declare-const sold Int)
(declare-const given Int)
(declare-const remaining Int)
(assert (= remaining 150))
(assert (= remaining (+ 108 sold given)))
(assert (= given 35))
(assert (= remaining (- 108 sold given)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (sold))

problem: Michael is traveling on the interstate at an average speed of 50km/hr (taking into account all the necessary stops for gas, relaxation, etc.). If he goes on like this for 3 days, what percentage of the distance between Alaska and Texas has he covered?
pred_smtlib:
(declare-const speed Real)
(declare-const time Real)
(declare-const distance_total Real)
(declare-const distance_covered Real)
(declare-const percentage Real)
(assert (= speed 50))
(assert (= time (* 3 24))) ; 3 days, assuming 24 hours per day
(assert (= distance_covered (* speed time)))
(assert (= distance_total 6789)) ; Approximate distance from Alaska to Texas in km
(assert (= percentage (/ (* 100 distance_covered) distance_total)))
(check-sat)
(get-value (percentage))
